info.title: Lody Cloud HTTP API — public client contract
info.description: Source-derived documentation of optional Lody Cloud HTTP clients. Hosted handlers are private: x-source identifies client evidence, not server validation. See README.md for coverage, credentials, protocol boundaries, and known discrepancies. This is not a promise that every route is available to third-party callers.

post.summary: Claim an encrypted machine pairing offer
post.description: Fixed HTTPS ingress pinned by an independently supplied pairing command. Persist and send the exact original JSON bytes on retry. Account bearer is absent: token and the prepared machine material identify the claim. Compare returned pairingSessionId and material with the command and local preparation; terminal conflict/cancellation/expiry requires a new command.
